item.title: Version 0.6.1
item.description:
What's New

  • Browse the Steam Workshop without a Web API key, with view and favorite counts
  • Weather effects: wind-leaning rain streaks, a new Mist effect, intensity-scaled density
  • Apple Music playhead with seek, liquid-glass overlay cards, board history shared across displays
  • Scene wallpapers respond to now-playing media, including $mediaThumbnail album art

Improvements

  • Workshop setup is one guided flow shared by Settings, onboarding and the Workshop pane
  • The Steam Web API key is optional and now stored in the keychain
  • SteamCMD recovers by restarting through its own self-update
  • WPE parsers survive malformed Workshop content instead of crashing or dropping valid parts of a scene
  • Switching the app language reaches file pickers and window titles without a restart
  • Bug reports scrub wallpaper names before prefilling a GitHub issue

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed the audio-response bug (#133)
  • The overlay master switch reliably stops the Monitor and Now Playing panels
  • Particles stay below app windows, and rain falls where it points
  • A Now Playing overlay could leave desktop clicks swallowed
  • "Apply to All Displays" for weather now copies the wind and intensity toggles
  • Republishing a system wallpaper kept dropping the old thumbnail

Not notarized — a hand-installed DMG needs xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen.app" once; updates installed by Loomscreen clear it for you. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
